body.label: Effect
body.html: Partially manifest the Beast in a charging strike against one creature within 3 units. On a success, deal 1 Bludgeoning damage and move it 1 unit.

surges.html: On a success, move the target 1 unit or prevent it from moving 1 unit on its next turn.
After this resolves, gain +1 Defense until your next turn as the entity partially overlays you.

rider.title: BEAST — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 4 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 2 additional Mana to fully manifest your Beast.
